nodes.name: Auto or manual?
nodes.notes: PUBLISH_MODE env var controls routing. Set to 'auto' to push straight to Instagram. Anything else routes to Telegram for manual review.

nodes.name: Instagram · Publish
nodes.notes: STUB. Real IG carousel publishing requires: (1) upload each image to a public URL or via Meta resumable upload, (2) create child media containers for each image, (3) create a carousel container referencing the child IDs, (4) publish the carousel container. See README → Instagram setup for the full sequence.
